name: Theology
overview: Theology, as revealed in Scripture, centers on the nature and identity of God as the self-existent I AM who sent His Son into the world. The Word, who was with God and was God from the beginning, demonstrates the divine nature of Christ and God's redemptive love through the gift of salvation by grace through faith. Believers are called to move beyond foundational doctrines like repentance and faith toward spiritual maturity, grounding their understanding in the doctrine of Christ.
